observedCombatPanel.provenance: accepted O14 run after required live-panel check

interpretation: With exactly one defended attack point per interval at the controlled 20/10 panel, 9 successful defended hits in 80 trials falls inside the predeclared exact central 99% Binomial(80,0.10) region. No multi-hit interval appeared. This narrowly validates executable use of BASE_CHANCE_TO_AVOID_HIT=90 as a 10% defended hit probability at the O14 boundary.
